characters.summary: Liu Kang is a master martial artist and Shaolin monk who utilizes expert hand-to-hand combat and fiery projectile attacks. He fights with supreme discipline, speed, and agility, closing distances quickly to overwhelm opponents.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to surprise attacks when distracted
Subject to standard human biological limitations
limitations: Relies on physical stamina and spiritual focus for chi generation.

sources.supports: Summary of biographical details, martial arts focus, and signature moves like the bicycle kick.

feats.claim: Defeated Shang Tsung and various other realm champions in mortal combat.

campaignTags.claim: Projects mystical fireballs and fire-enhanced kicks.
Generates and channels fiery chi energy into offensive techniques.

unknowns: Exact limits of mortal physical durability against supernatural attacks.

characters.summary: Having merged with Raiden, Fire God Liu Kang possesses divine authority and mastery over lightning and fire. He overwhelms foes with immense cosmic power, teleportation, and transcendent martial arts.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to similarly matched divine entities or Kronika's time magic
characters.formDifferences: Transforms from a mortal martial artist into a divine entity wielding combined fire and lightning dominion, granting flight and reality-shaping power.

sources.supports: Details regarding Fire God Liu Kang in Mortal Kombat 11 story campaign.

unknowns: Full upper limits of his newly acquired temporal powers.

characters.summary: Luigi is an agile plumber who relies on high jumps, hesitant bravery, and a variety of power-ups. He maneuvers through platforms with exaggerated momentum and floating leaps.
limitations: Poor ground traction makes stopping difficult.

sources.supports: Luigi character profile, abilities, and signature moves across the Super Mario series.

feats.claim: Rescued captured allies from haunted mansions using the Poltergust.

notableResults.note: Utilized the Poltergust vacuum device to capture ghosts.

campaignTags.claim: Performs extended flutter jumps and soaring leaps.

unknowns: Exact physical strength ceiling without power-ups.

characters.summary: Ice Luigi projects freezing projectiles that encase enemies in solid blocks of ice. He maintains standard plumber mobility combined with elemental ice manipulation.
weaknesses: Power-up is lost upon taking enemy damage
characters.formDifferences: Changes clothing color to light blue and grants the ability to throw ice balls.

sources.supports: Description of the Ice Flower power-up and Ice Luigi capabilities.

unknowns: Duration of the ice flower transformation without taking damage.

characters.summary: Invincible Super Star Luigi radiates flashing rainbow energy, obliterating any enemy on contact. He moves with extreme speed and chaotic energy during the power-up's brief window.

mechanisms: Complete invulnerability to all standard damage sources

characters.formDifferences: Grants complete temporary invulnerability and one-touch defeat of opponents.

sources.supports: Super Star mechanics and invulnerability effects.

unknowns: Exact duration timers across different game titles.

characters.summary: M. Bison is the ruthless dictator of Shadaloo who channels malevolent Psycho Power. He combines brutal physical strikes with rapid teleportation, psychokinetic crushing attacks, and overwhelming aggression.
weaknesses: Reliance on spare surrogate bodies when his physical vessel breaks down
limitations: Physical bodies degrade over time due to intense Psycho Power strain.

sources.supports: M. Bison biography, Psycho Power usage, and role as primary antagonist in Street Fighter.

feats.claim: Conquered and manipulated global criminal syndicates through terror and combat supremacy.

notableResults.note: Fought to stalemates and interrupted conflicts repeatedly.

campaignTags.claim: Channels and manifests Psycho Power for attacks and barriers.
Instantly teleports short distances across the battlefield.

unknowns: Exact limit of surrogate body capacity.

characters.summary: Marcus Fenix is a hardened military veteran who relies on heavy tactical weaponry, cover-based combat, and brutal close-quarters chainsaw executions. He excels in prolonged firefights and endurance.
weaknesses: Vulnerable when caught in open areas without cover
Dependent on ammunition and weapon supplies
limitations: Limited mobility without vehicles; relies on standard human physical movement.

sources.supports: Marcus Fenix background, military gear, and role in Gears of War.

feats.claim: Led the Coalition of Ordered Governments to victory against the Locust Horde and Lambent.

notableResults.note: Defeated after intense firefight aboard a train.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes standard-issue military comms, grenades, and weapon attachments.

unknowns: Performance in environments completely devoid of ballistic cover.

characters.summary: Mario is an extraordinarily versatile hero who uses exceptional jumping ability, immense physical strength feats, and a massive arsenal of power-ups to overcome obstacles and adversaries.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to hazard surfaces like lava and spikes without specific power-ups
limitations: Base form lacks ranged attacks without items.

sources.supports: Overview of Mario's abilities, jumping feats, and history across the franchise.

feats.claim: Consistently defeats Bowser and saves the Mushroom Kingdom across numerous campaigns.

notableResults.note: Overcomes Bowser's mechanical vehicles and breath attacks.

campaignTags.claim: Performs sustained soaring and gliding leaps using special cap items.

characters.summary: Cat Mario utilizes feline agility, sharp claws for vertical wall-climbing, and rapid scratching pounces to corner enemies and scale sheer surfaces.
weaknesses: Suit is lost upon sustaining damage from enemies
characters.formDifferences: Adopts a cat suit enabling vertical wall climbs, scratching attacks, and a downward aerial dive.

sources.supports: Super Bell power-up capabilities and Cat Mario mechanics.

unknowns: Duration of the cat transformation without enemy disruption.

characters.summary: Fire Mario hurls bouncing balls of fire at enemies from a distance, combining his standard acrobatic prowess with projectile elemental offense.

mechanisms: Eliminating threats at range before they approach

weaknesses: Hit reverts Mario to standard base form
characters.formDifferences: Changes outfit colors to white and red, granting the ability to generate and throw continuous bouncing fireballs.

sources.supports: Fire Flower power-up and Fire Mario projectile abilities.

unknowns: Maximum range and bounce count of projected fireballs.
